reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Sponsoring UN resolutions and observances on AI
themes.definition: The speaker presents its own initiatives in the UN General Assembly on AI, such as sponsored resolutions, proclaimed international days, or proposed UN-auspiced codes and dialogues.
themes.inclusion: Include passages that report or propose a UNGA resolution, international day, or UN-auspiced instrument specifically about AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude UN initiatives on unrelated topics (water, transport, peace decades) that do not mention AI.
themes.boundary_cases: A proposal for a UN-auspiced AI code for diplomacy counts here and also under AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE when it calls for rules.

examples.quote: On August 31st, the General Assembly proclaimed the International Day of Safe, Secure and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence, also at the initiative of Tajikistan.
I propose that the General Assembly adopt a special draft resolution on the role of artificial intelligence in creating new opportunities for socioeconomic development

themes.label: AI as driver of sustainable development
themes.definition: AI is framed as a tool that can accelerate the Sustainable Development Goals and socioeconomic development.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI or AI plus digital technologies contribute to SDGs, development, or compressing decades of development.
themes.exclusion: Exclude mentions of digitalization for development that do not reference AI.
themes.boundary_cases: If AI is linked to development but the main point is reducing inequality between countries, also code AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: the rapid adoption of digital technologies and the effective use of artificial intelligence can noticeably contribute to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals
used well and shared widely, AI could compress decades of development into years

themes.label: Regional AI centres and cooperation
themes.definition: Proposals for regional AI institutions, centres, or expert dialogues hosted by the speaker to coordinate AI projects among neighbouring countries.
themes.inclusion: Include proposals to host a regional AI centre or regional/international AI expert dialogue in the speaker's capital.
themes.exclusion: Exclude purely national AI strategies with no regional or multilateral hosting dimension.
themes.boundary_cases: An expert dialogue hosted nationally but framed as international on responsible AI can be coded here and AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: This center would undoubtedly facilitate an implementation of joint initiatives and projects among Central Asian countries in the field of artificial intelligence.
we propose convening in Ashgabat an international expert dialogue on digital trust and the responsible use of AI

themes.label: Responsible international governance of AI
themes.definition: Calls for responsible international rules or codes for AI to prevent its use against peace, security and trust.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for international governance, codes of conduct, or safe/secure/trustworthy AI norms.
themes.exclusion: Exclude statements only praising AI opportunities without any governance element.
themes.boundary_cases: The phrase 'safe and equitable use' of AI tied to a resolution counts when framed as a governing instrument.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence offers broad opportunities while also requiring responsible international governance to prevent its use and to detriment of peace, security, and trust.
an international code for the peaceful use of AI in international relations and diplomacy

themes.label: AI must reduce, not deepen, division
themes.definition: Concern that AI could become a new source of division and inequality, with calls for it to reduce inequality instead.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI should not divide societies or countries and should reduce inequality.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general development claims about AI without an inequality or division frame.
themes.boundary_cases: Statements on 'equitable use' of AI in a region are borderline; code here only if inequality is explicit.

examples.quote: AI should not become another source of division. It should become a force for development, opportunity, and reducing inequality.

value.rationale: All passages come from Central Asian speeches that promote the speaker's own UN initiatives on AI (resolutions, an international day, a code, regional centres) and frame AI mainly as a development opportunity. Turkmenistan adds a governance-for-peace framing, while Tajikistan 2026 adds an inequality concern.
